IRS990.Desc: THE U.S. IMMIGRATION POLICY PROGRAM ANALYZES U.S. POLICIES AND THEIR IMPACTS, AS WELL AS THE COMPLEX DEMOGRAPHIC, ECONOMIC, POLITICAL, FOREIGN POLICY, AND OTHER FORCES THAT SHAPE IMMIGRATION TO THE UNITED STATES. THE PROGRAM ALSO OFFERS INFLUENTIAL THOUGHT LEADERSHIP AND POLICY RECOMMENDATIONS REGARDING WAYS TO IMPROVE THE U.S. IMMIGRATION SYSTEM SO THAT IT WORKS MOST EFFECTIVELY IN THE NATIONAL INTEREST.THE NATIONAL CENTER ON IMMIGRANT INTEGRATION POLICY IS A CROSSROADS FOR ELECTED OFFICIALS, RESEARCHERS, STATE AND LOCAL AGENCY MANAGERS, GRASSROOTS LEADERS, SERVICE PROVIDERS, AND OTHERS WHO SEEK TO UNDERSTAND AND RESPOND TO THE CHALLENGES AND OPPORTUNITIES TODAY'S HIGH RATES OF IMMIGRATION CREATE IN LOCAL COMMUNITIES.MPI'S INTERNATIONAL PROGRAM CONDUCTS RESEARCH AND ANALYSIS TO DEVELOP INNOVATIVE, EVIDENCE-BASED, AND POLITICALLY FEASIBLE SOLUTIONS TO WORLDWIDE MIGRATION POLICY CHALLENGES.

GrantsToOrgOutsideUSGrp.PurposeOfGrantTxt: SUBGRANT SUPPORTING EDUCATION ACCESS AND INTEGRATION

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION MONITORS THE USE OF FUNDS WITH GRANT REPORTS AND CLOSE COMMUNICATIONS WITH THE ORGANIZATIONS UTILIZING THE FUNDS.

THE ORGANIZATION IDENTIFIES POTENTIAL GRANTEES BASED ON PRIOR ACTIVITIES IN THE AREA OF IMMIGRANT INTEGRATION. THE GRANTEES THAT OUR ORGANIZATION HAS WORKED WITH IN THE INTEGRATION FIELD ARE WELL KNOWN TO THE ORGANIZATION. WHEN REQUIRED, THE ORGANIZATION VETS RECIPIENTS BY CHECKING REFERENCES, AND BY REVIEWING ANY PUBLICLY AVAILABLE DOCUMENTS. THESE GRANTS ARE AWARDED IN ORDER TO HELP FACILITATE THEIR WORK. THERE IS CONTINUED DIALOGUE WITH EACH GRANTEE AS WELL AS THE SUBMISSION OF REPORTING REQUIREMENTS DURING THE GRANT PERIOD, TO ENSURE THAT THE FUNDS ARE BEING USED FOR THEIR INTENDED PURPOSES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE FORM 990 WAS PREPARED BY THE OUTSIDE ACCOUNTANTS AND REVIEWED BY THE PRESIDENT AND THE DIRECTOR OF FINANCE. AFTER THE FORM WAS APPROVED BY THESE PERSONS, THE FORM WAS E-MAILED TO ALL MEMBERS OF THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: EACH YEAR, BOARD MEMBERS, OFFICERS, AND KEY EMPLOYEES REVIEW THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY AND COMPLETE A CONFLICT OF INTEREST DISCLOSURE STATEMENT. EACH NEW COVERED PERSON MUST REVIEW A COPY OF THE POLICY AND IS REMINDED OF THE OBLIGATION TO CONFORM TO IT. EACH COVERED PERSON MUST COMPLETE A CONFLICT OF INTEREST INFORMATION FORM IDENTIFYING ANY RELATIONSHIPS, POSITIONS, OR CIRCUMSTANCES IN WHICH THE COVERED PERSON IS INVOLVED THAT COULD CREATE A CONFLICT OF INTEREST. IF A BOARD MEMBER HAS A CONFLICT OF INTEREST ON A MATTER BEFORE THE BOARD, THE COVERED PERSON DISCLOSES ALL RELEVANT FACTS TO THE BOARD, IS NOT PERMITTED TO HEAR THE BOARD DISCUSSION REGARDING THE MATTER EXCEPT TO DISCLOSE MATERIAL FACTS, MUST NOT SEEK TO INFLUENCE BOARD MEMBERS REGARDING THE MATTER, AND IS NOT PERMITTED TO VOTE ON THE MATTER. BOARD MINUTES FOR THE MEETING REFLECT THE DISCLOSURE OF THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST AND THE FACT THAT THE BOARD MEMBER WAS NOT PERMITTED TO DISCUSS OR VOTE ON THE MATTER. THE BOARD MEMBER WITH A CONFLICT OF INTEREST WILL NOT BE COUNTED AS A MEMBER FOR THE PURPOSES OF ESTABLISHING A QUORUM OF THE BOARD. IF A BOARD MEMBER IS NOT CERTAIN WHETHER OR NOT A CONFLICT OF INTEREST EXISTS, THEN THE BOARD MEMBER MUST DISCLOSE ALL RELEVANT FACTS TO THE BOARD AND THE BOARD MAKES A DETERMINATION OF WHETHER OR NOT A CONFLICT EXISTS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15A
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES PERFORMS AN ANNUAL REVIEW OF THE COMPENSATION OF THE PRESIDENT, WHO SERVES AS THE CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER. THE PRESIDENT COMPLETES A SELF-EVALUATION. A COMPILATION OF COMPENSATION INFORMATION FOR OTHER CEOS OF SIMILAR NONPROFIT ORGANIZATIONS BASED ON DATA FROM THEIR FORM 990S IS PROVIDED TO THE BOARD BY THE DIRECTOR OF FINANCE & ADMINISTRATION. THE BOARD THEN MEETS IN AN EXECUTIVE SESSION TO DISCUSS AND VOTE ON ANY ADJUSTMENTS ON THE COMPENSATION FOR THE PRESIDENT AND MAKES FORMAL NOTES OF THE BOARD ACTIONS TAKEN. A DESIGNATED BOARD MEMBER PROVIDES THE DIRECTOR OF FINANCE & ADMINISTRATION WITH THE RESULTS OF THE MEETING THAT INCLUDES THE SPECIFIC SALARY ACTION TO BE TAKEN. THE LAST COMPENSATION REVIEW TOOK PLACE IN JULY 2024.
